ideas.idea: Render FAQ answers as visible page text, not only in JSON-LD
ideas.why: index.astro emits the FAQ only inside the script tag, so the answers aren't visible on the page.

ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization structured data on contact page (and Product/Offer for pricing)
ideas.why: The contact page has a phone number and location, and the moorings page has a price, but neither has any structured data.

ideas.idea: Add a table of mooring sizes and seasonal rates to moorings page
ideas.why: The description promises sizes and seasonal prices, but the page has only one price line.

ideas.idea: Add in-text links from home page to /moorings and /contact
ideas.why: The nav already links these pages, so in-text links add little.

ideas.idea: Set `site` in Astro config and use @astrojs/sitemap instead of hand-kept sitemap
ideas.why: There is no astro.config, and a `site` value is needed for correct absolute canonicals and keeps the sitemap in sync.
It is accurate but has little effect on a three-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and Open Graph tags to the layout
ideas.why: The head really lacks them, but this is standard boilerplate that applies to nearly any site.
It is a standard semantic landmark that would apply to nearly any site and has little effect.

ideas.idea: Make the contact page title name Falmouth/the harbour
ideas.why: The title "Contact the harbour office" really omits the place, and naming it helps identify the page.

ideas.idea: Fix the mixed Harbor/harbour spelling in the home title
ideas.why: The home title uses "Harbor" while the page text uses "harbour", so the site name is inconsistent for searchers and machines.
